projects.title: Best Anime Awards
projects.subtitle: Describes the best rated anime of the corresponding year
projects.description: This website is an assignment made for web2 which ranks the best anime bases on their year of release and provides their ratings and wallpapers for the years inquired.
projects.footer: I used NodeJs, NPM, Express for this project.

projects.title: AI Prompt Generator Form
projects.subtitle: Generates a form to get a result from the ai
projects.description: This was an assignment for web2 which includes a single page form that that requires you to fill out a form and then spouts out a prompt that you can give to an ai to generate a story based on your choices
projects.footer: I used NodeJs, NPM, Express for this project.

projects.title: Library Book Collection
projects.subtitle: A database entry program
projects.description: This is a java springboot project that has a database entry system for different types of book types. You can enter different types of information regarding the books like ID, Title, author and different imformation for specific types.
projects.footer: I used Java springboot, Thymeleaf and mySQL database for this project.

projects.title: Mareen Life
projects.subtitle: A game promoting save oceans
projects.description: This is a game I made in 10th standard for a game jam and I won second prize in this. The theme was save oceans and in this game the objective was to keep the ocean clean for as long as possible from the falling debris.

projects.title: Evergreen
projects.subtitle: Self recharging electric car
projects.description: This is a project made by me and my friend for a national competition in which we made a student counter for school buses so that it keeps track of when and where the students got off to alert the driver and also an automatic speed control and brake system for school buses in case of really foggy weathers which are really severe back home.
projects.footer: I used arduino, C++ for this project.
